text.div:
AARP Medicare Advantage from UHC FL-0021 (PPO)

Carrier: UnitedHealthcare. Plan type: PPO. Period: 2027 to 2027.

14 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 13 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document AARP_MEDICARE_ADVANTAGE_FROM_UHC_FL_0021_PPO_H2406_013_000 (schema version 1.2.0).

extension.valueString: CMS Plan Benefit Package (PBP) Benefits, contract year 2027, release "PBP Benefits-2027" (https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/pbp-benefits-2027.zip), downloaded 2026-10-06. Files read: pbp_Section_A.txt, pbp_Section_C.txt, pbp_Section_C_OON.txt, pbp_Section_C_POS.txt, pbp_Section_D.txt, pbp_b10_amb_trans.txt, pbp_b13_other_services.txt, pbp_b17_eye_exams_wear.txt, pbp_b18_hearing_exams_aids.txt, pbp_b1a_inpat_hosp.txt, pbp_b1b_inpat_hosp.txt, pbp_b2_snf.txt, pbp_b4_emerg_urgent.txt, pbp_b7_health_prof.txt, pbp_b8_clin_diag_ther.txt, pbp_b9_outpat_hosp.txt, PlanArea.txt, PlanRegionArea.txt. PBP key: pbp_a_hnumber "H2406", pbp_a_plan_identifier "013", segment_id "0" (written padded to 3 digits in plan_identifiers).
Plan type: pbp_a_plan_type "04" (Local PPO), written as plan_type "PPO".

Section A values with no Benefit Plan Standard field, verbatim: bid_id "H2406_013_0"; version "5"; orgtype "01"; pbp_a_org_name "CARE IMPROVEMENT PLUS SOUTH CENTRAL INSURANCE CO."; pbp_a_org_type "01"; pbp_a_ben_cov "1"; pbp_a_plan_geog_name "Select Counties in Florida"; pbp_a_eghp_yn "2"; pbp_a_special_need_flag "2"; pbp_a_contract_partd_flag "1"; pbp_a_continue_yn "2"; pbp_a_org_website "AARPMedicarePlans.com"; pbp_a_phys_web_addr "AARPMedicarePlans.com"; pbp_a_formulary_web_addr "AARPMedicarePlans.com"; pbp_a_pharmacy_website "AARPMedicarePlans.com".

Service area from PlanArea.txt, 7 counties in FL. county_code is the SSA state and county code, not FIPS, so service_area.counties[].fips is null. Each county as county_code, county, stcd, and the partial_flag and eghp_flag values on its rows: 10090 Clay FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10150 Duval FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10170 Flagler FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10440 Nassau FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10530 Putnam FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10540 St. Johns FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0"; 10630 Volusia FL partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0".

Annual plan deductible: $1000, written as oon_individual_deductible with network_tier OUT (decision 1, docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 7). The plan declares an out-of-network benefit (pbp_c_oon_yn "1") and the deductible names no in-network scope: pbp_d_ann_deduct_yn "1", pbp_d_ann_deduct_amt_type "4", pbp_d_ann_deduct_amt "1000.00", pbp_d_ann_deduct_bens "", pbp_d_ann_deduct_inn_mc_yn "", pbp_d_ann_deduct_inn_nmc_yn "", pbp_d_ann_deduct_oon_nmc_yn "". The deductible's service categories, verbatim: pbp_d_ann_deduct_14a_yn "2"; pbp_c_oon_mc_bendesc_cats "1a;1b;2;3-1;3-2;3-3;3-4;5a;5b;6;7a;7b;7c;7d;7e1;7e2;7f;7g;7h1;7h2;7i;7k;8a1;8a2;8b1;8b2;8b3;9a1;9a2;9b;9c1;9c2;9d;10a1;10a2;11a;11b1;11b2;11c1;11c2;11c3;12;14a;14d;14e1;14e2;14e4;14e5;15-1-I;15-2;15-3;16a;17a;17b;18a;". pbp_d_ann_deduct_14a_yn asks whether 14a preventive services are part of the out-of-network Medicare-covered services deductible; the categories are those of the plan's out-of-network benefit, less 14a when that answer is "2". Verified on H2406-013-000 against its 2027 Summary of Benefits; to be confirmed on 2 more PPO carriers.
